description: This file defines the PHPMailer POP3 class, implementing lightweight support for RFC1939 POP-before-SMTP authentication, including connection management, authentication, and error handling.

classes.name: PHPMailer\POP3
classes.description: Class encapsulating POP3 protocol communication for authentication purposes within the PHPMailer package.

methods.name: popBeforeSmtp
methods.description: Static method providing an all-in-one POP-before-SMTP authentication process, returning true if authentication succeeded.

methods.name: authorise
methods.description: Performs connection and login sequence to validate POP3 credentials for SMTP relay authorization.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes a socket connection to a specified POP3 server.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Logs into the POP3 server with provided or stored credentials.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Reads a line from the POP3 server response.

methods.name: sendString
methods.description: Sends a raw string command to the POP3 server.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks if server response begins with +OK indicating success.

methods.name: setError
methods.description: Records an error message internally and optionally outputs debug info.

methods.name: getErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of error messages accumulated during operation.

methods.name: catchWarning
methods.description: Handles PHP warnings during socket connection attempts, records them as errors.
